hunks.baseline: At least, that was how it felt to the East Depot masters charging at the vanguard, scrambling over the rubble of the collapsed outer wall.
hunks.sol: At least, that was how it felt to the East Depot masters charging at the vanguard as they scrambled over the rubble of the collapsed outer wall.

hunks.baseline: The dazzling flash washed over their vision, leaving them stunned for a moment. It was the last thing they ever saw.
hunks.sol: A dazzling flash filled their vision. For a moment, they could only stare. It was the last thing they ever saw.

hunks.baseline: A tremendous roar battered their ears. An irresistible force swept over their bodies, frozen like stone statues.
hunks.sol: A tremendous roar battered their ears. An irresistible force swept through their bodies, frozen like stone statues.

hunks.baseline: *Crack! Fwoosh!*
hunks.sol: *Crunch! Fwoosh!*

hunks.sol: The flash vanished as quickly as it had come. One of the East Depot eunuchs charging behind his comrades blinked.

hunks.baseline: Then, as his vision finally cleared, he understood.
hunks.sol: When his vision finally cleared, he understood.

hunks.baseline: That flash had been Force someone had sent flying.
hunks.sol: That flash had been Force fired by someone.

hunks.baseline: His pupils, fixed on what remained of his former comrades, sent the impossible sight to his brain: chunks of meat so mangled he could no longer tell what they had been.
hunks.sol: His eyes took in what remained of the men who had once been his comrades: chunks of meat so mangled he could no longer tell who was who. His mind struggled to accept the sight.

hunks.baseline: Only then did pain reach him from his shoulder, horribly shredded as though a beast had torn into it.
hunks.sol: Only then did pain reach him from his shoulder, left in shreds as though a beast had torn into it.

hunks.baseline: But he wasn’t the only one consumed by shock and pain in that moment.
hunks.sol: But he wasn’t the only one caught in shock and pain.

hunks.baseline: Some groaned as they clutched their severed legs. Some pleaded desperately for help on the brink of death. Others bent over and vomited at the carnage before their eyes.
hunks.sol: Some groaned as they clutched the stumps of their severed legs. Some pleaded desperately for help on the brink of death. Others bent over and vomited at the carnage before their eyes.

hunks.baseline: They trembled, terrified by the gruesome deaths they’d witnessed with their own eyes, helpless to do anything.
hunks.sol: They trembled, terrified by the gruesome deaths they’d witnessed and helpless to do anything.

hunks.baseline: A single strike had killed or incapacitated more than fifty soldiers.
hunks.sol: A single strike had killed or incapacitated some fifty soldiers.

hunks.sol: Each had charged at the vanguard without hesitation, and each was a formidable fighter, ranging from Supreme First Rate to Peak.

hunks.baseline: Compared to the full force of some three thousand, it wasn’t a major loss. But everyone had stopped because that one attack had swallowed dozens of Peak masters in its terrifying power.
hunks.sol: Compared to a force of nearly three thousand, the loss was not great. Yet everyone had stopped. One attack had swallowed dozens of Peak masters with terrifying power.

hunks.baseline: No—it was because of the master whose might seemed almost demonic.
hunks.sol: No—it was the master behind that attack, whose might seemed almost demonic, who had stopped them.

hunks.baseline: The Embroidered Uniform Guard and Fire Dragon Pavilion members fighting the dead who kept rising no matter how many times they were killed.
hunks.sol: The Embroidered Uniform Guard and Fire Dragon Pavilion members fighting the dead, who refused to fall no matter how many times they were killed.

hunks.baseline: Even the dead, who had lost what little reason they had left when the bell was destroyed, stopped moving at some instinctive warning.
hunks.sol: Even the dead, driven still further out of their minds when the bell was destroyed, stopped at some instinctive warning.

hunks.baseline: A breeze from somewhere stirred the woman’s thick hair.
hunks.sol: A breeze stirred the woman’s thick hair.

hunks.baseline: In the silence that had fallen over the hall, a cry like a scream rang out belatedly. The woman—no, So Gyo—lifted her head and looked toward the voice.
hunks.sol: In the silence that had fallen over the hall, a belated cry rang out, almost a scream. The woman—no, So Gyo—lifted her head toward the voice.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, at the person standing there.
hunks.sol: More precisely, toward the person standing there.

hunks.baseline: Her lips moved silently, and her dark blue eyes sank deep.
hunks.sol: Her lips moved without a sound, and her dark blue eyes grew solemn.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of steps leading up to the dais were already buried beneath countless bodies.
hunks.sol: The hundreds of steps leading up to the dais were already buried beneath countless bodies.

hunks.sol: The thousand or so dead had been torn to shreds and finally killed—or lay there writhing with their limbs severed.

hunks.baseline: As if hoping someone would put an end to their tenacious lives.
hunks.sol: As if hoping someone would put an end to their stubborn lives.

hunks.sol: The man who had split in two a dead man crawling up the steps on his one remaining arm lowered his sword and breathed hard.

hunks.baseline: His golden armor and sword, exquisitely ornate as works of art, felt heavier than ever.
hunks.sol: His golden armor and sword, as intricate and splendid as works of art, felt heavier than ever.

hunks.sol: The Embroidered Uniform Guard who had turned to ash here today had also been prepared to die.

hunks.sol: To pity them for a sacrifice they had chosen would be an insult worse than death.

hunks.baseline: Even if the man was the most exalted person beneath the heavens, the one above all others.
hunks.sol: Even if he was the most exalted man beneath the heavens, the one who stood above all others.

hunks.baseline: Then he addressed the foremost military commander of the imperial court, who had done more than anyone to protect the late Emperor and the imperial family, and who had repeatedly lifted him back to his feet with harsh reprimands whenever he faltered. hunks.sol: He turned to the imperial court’s foremost military commander. Baek Yeon had done more than anyone to protect the late Emperor and the imperial family, and whenever the Emperor faltered, Baek Yeon’s harsh rebukes had lifted him back to his feet. He was more a comrade than a subject.
So the Emperor gave him a request, not an order.

hunks.baseline: Taking in the Emperor’s exhaustion, his fatigue more visible than ever, he bowed deeply and extended a palm toward the great drum that had announced the start of the banquet.
hunks.sol: He took in the Emperor’s face, more exhausted than he had ever seen it, then bowed deeply and thrust a palm toward the great drum that had announced the start of the banquet.

hunks.baseline: The drumbeat, charged with his profound internal energy, rang out without end.
hunks.sol: The drumbeat, charged with profound internal energy, rang out without end.

hunks.baseline: It carried the heart of a warrior who had waited a long time for this day. It carried the Emperor’s will.
hunks.sol: It carried the heart of a warrior who had waited so long for this day. It carried the Emperor’s will.

hunks.baseline: Then again.
hunks.sol: Then once again.

hunks.sol: The sound was immense enough for everyone in the grand banquet hall to hear. No—it rolled like a wave that might sweep across the entire Imperial Capital.

hunks.baseline: Even when the third drumbeat rang out, the three thousand rebels didn’t know what to do. They hesitated.
hunks.sol: Even when the third drumbeat rang out, the nearly three thousand rebels could only hesitate.

hunks.baseline: Everything had unfolded so naturally.
hunks.sol: It had all unfolded so naturally.

hunks.baseline: So Gyo’s overwhelming display of martial power had abruptly swept through the vanguard, and the drumbeat resounded with a grandeur they couldn’t explain. For a moment, they had been overwhelmed before they even knew it.
hunks.sol: So Gyo’s sudden, overwhelming attack on the vanguard. The drumbeat, resounding with a grandeur they could not explain. Before they knew it, they had been overwhelmed.

hunks.baseline: The Imperial Guards and East Depot leadership who had already betrayed the imperial court and the Great Nation to join Dark Heaven were thrown into confusion. They looked at one another, their eyes bewildered.
hunks.sol: The Imperial Guards and East Depot leaders who had betrayed the imperial court and the Great Nation to join Dark Heaven looked at one another in confusion.

hunks.baseline: Even when they had seized every gate leading into the imperial palace and defeated the remaining defenders, taking advantage of another allied force sweeping through the capital, they had been certain a new age was about to begin.
hunks.sol: When another allied force swept through the Imperial Capital and they used the opportunity to seal every gate leading into the imperial palace and defeat its remaining defenders, they had been certain a new order was about to begin.

hunks.baseline: But the reality they’d met with such joy—and the battle that should already have been theirs—had turned out differently.
hunks.sol: But the reality they had so eagerly come to meet was different. The battle should have been theirs already.

hunks.baseline: The drumbeat rang out once again, reaching their ears.
hunks.sol: Another drumbeat reached their ears.

hunks.baseline: Instinctively, every hair on their bodies stood on end. A chill ran down their spines.
hunks.sol: Every hair on their bodies stood on end. A chill ran down their spines.

hunks.baseline: The fourth drumbeat was no louder than the ones before it, nor did it have a deeper, more resonant ring.
hunks.sol: The fourth drumbeat was no louder than the ones before it. Nor did it have the same deep, resonant power.

hunks.baseline: But there was only one reason it made the rebels’ hearts sink more than ever.
hunks.sol: Yet it made the rebels’ hearts sink for one reason alone.

hunks.baseline: The sound came not from Baek Yeon, visible in the distance, but from somewhere behind them.
hunks.sol: It came not from Baek Yeon, visible in the distance, but from somewhere behind their backs.

hunks.baseline: And then it spread in every direction.
hunks.sol: Then more answered it from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Countless drumbeats spread like flames sweeping across a wide plain. They weren’t echoes bouncing back from somewhere, nor were they hearing things.
hunks.sol: The countless drumbeats spread like flames across a wide plain. They were not echoes bouncing back from somewhere. They were not a trick of the ears.

hunks.baseline: They were the signal that this long and gruesome banquet was coming to an end—the footsteps of hunters closing in on prey at last caught in a trap.
hunks.sol: They were the signal that this long and gruesome banquet was coming to an end—the footsteps of hunters closing in on prey caught at last in a trap.

hunks.baseline: How long had this been going on?
hunks.sol: When had this begun?

hunks.sol: The realization struck like lightning through their skulls. At the same time, the rebels felt immense tremors drawing closer.

hunks.baseline: Then they saw it.
hunks.sol: Then they saw them.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of flags rising high around them at last.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of flags rising high on every side.

hunks.baseline: Following the fluttering flags, a dragon embroidered in golden thread writhed as though alive.
hunks.sol: On the fluttering flags, dragons embroidered in golden thread seemed to writhe as though alive.

hunks.baseline: Unseen shock, joy, and despair swept across the grand banquet hall.
hunks.sol: Shock, joy, and despair swept across the grand banquet hall.

hunks.sol: Some were seized by an elation so intense their hearts felt ready to burst. Others clenched their teeth until they bled.

hunks.baseline: No one could guess the exact number of their enemies, but one thing was certain.
hunks.sol: No one could guess the exact number of their enemies, but one thing was certain: the forces tightening the encirclement would overwhelm them.

hunks.baseline: Even now, the force of the enemy closing in around them would overwhelm them.

hunks.sol: The victor was king; the loser, a rebel.

hunks.sol: Already driven to the edge of a cliff, they had no other choice.

hunks.sol: “Whoever captures the Emperor and his family will be made a marquis! Your descendants will enjoy wealth and glory for generations!”

hunks.sol: The hundred or so *jang* between them meant nothing now.

hunks.sol: Swallowing those words, So Gyo looked down at the battlefield spread out beneath her.

hunks.sol: The grand banquet hall, stretching for hundreds of *jang* in either direction, was awash with blood. Ownerless weapons and severed limbs lay scattered across the ground. The wide-open eyes of the dead held no trace of life.

hunks.baseline: Only death had filled the silence left behind when the music briefly fell quiet, and now more people were surging in to paint another layer of death over it.
hunks.sol: The music that had sounded for a brief while was gone. Only death remained in its place, and more people were surging in to pile death upon death.

hunks.baseline: Amid the enemies’ thunderous shouts, a cold wind blew from somewhere, billowing her silky hair into a lush cloud.
hunks.sol: Amid the enemies’ thunderous shouts, a cold wind billowed her silky hair. It carried the smell of blood deep into her nose, thick as the crimson pools all around her.

hunks.baseline: The smell of blood, carried by the wind and seeping deep into her nose, was as thick as the crimson pools of blood collected all around her.
Thick enough to dredge up fragments of a past submerged by time.
hunks.sol: Thick enough to draw fragments of the past up from where time had buried them.

hunks.baseline: Thick enough to revive the horrific memories she’d wanted to forget but never could.
hunks.sol: To bring back the horrific memories she had wanted to forget but never could.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps that was why she felt not even the slightest joy, despite having found the answer and key she had searched for so long.
hunks.sol: Perhaps that was why she felt not the slightest joy, though she had found the answer—the key—she had sought for so long.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps that was why she felt certain the time had come to end this long and gruesome banquet.
hunks.sol: Perhaps that was why she knew it was time to end this long and gruesome banquet.

hunks.sol: In the silence, So Gyo moved both hands. The two curved swords gripped in her blood-caked hands pointed toward sky and earth. Then she brought them together.
